law_name: Personal Data Protection Law (Law No. 81 of 2019)
jurisdiction: ANTAI - National Authority for Transparency and Access to Information
scope: Individuals (nationals & foreigners) whose data is held in Panama
applies_to: Controllers domiciled in Panama or with databases located in Panama
key_requirements: Consent, purpose limitation, data subject rights (ARCO & portability), international transfer rules
retention_period: Retention tied to purpose; data may not be transferred 7 years after legal retention obligation ends unless subject requests (article not confirmed)
enforcement_authority: National Authority for Transparency and Access to Information (ANTAI)
penalties_range: Up to USD 10,000 fine (B/.1,000-10,000); database registry closure or suspension of processing
deceased_data: Not confirmed in statute; academic commentary frames ARCO rights as belonging to living persons (unconfirmed)
genetic_data: Genetic data treated as sensitive data (regulator ANTAI guidance); reinforced security and explicit consent rules for sensitive data
notes: Regulated by Executive Decree 285 of 2021; 2022 reform proposals not confirmed enacted
